about: Attack-arc wave 6, ancestral druid forms AFTER the ground pass (2026-11-15, user-approved rebuild). Files: worktree shields-mount assets/models/form_alpha.glb (md5 e2df2a85...) and form_ent.glb (md5 5d76a2b9..., round 6: -X arm lifted to the ground in maul/attack). Same reader/conventions as attack-arcs-wave6-ancestral.json: 24 fps, frames 1-based, model space x = +X of the model, y up, z forward, metres BEFORE FORM_SCALE (alpha 1.4, ent 1.2). tip = front-most vertex (alpha) / lowest vertex (ent) of the piece in idle frame 1; low_pt = lowest vertex of the piece in that frame.
